## P16-Q1 — five panel ecosystems

Status: `confirmed-patterns`

Query:

> Use only official primary documentation or official source repositories. Compare Filament,
> Laravel Nova, Orchid Platform, Backpack for Laravel and MoonShine on Panel, Resource, Page,
> Screen, Dashboard and navigation, then assess the narrow name `corex/panels`.

Observed Perplexity synthesis:

- Filament treats a Panel as an aggregate/runtime scope containing resources, pages and widgets.
- Nova centers Resource, Dashboard and Menu rather than a public Panel aggregate.
- Orchid centers Screen as the page-level unit.
- Backpack distinguishes the admin area and model-oriented CRUD panels.
- MoonShine uses admin panel as the product shell and exposes Resource, Page/Dashboard and Menu
  concepts; the first broad answer omitted its URLs, so a focused follow-up and direct primary
  lookup were used before carrying the claim.

Bounded conclusion: ecosystem vocabulary supports keeping `panels` only if CoreX explicitly
defines its own headless scope. It does not justify adding framework-specific Page/Resource/UI
types.

Primary URLs checked separately:

- https://filamentphp.com/docs/5.x/panel-configuration
- https://filamentphp.com/docs/5.x/resources/overview
- https://nova.laravel.com/docs/v5/resources/the-basics
- https://nova.laravel.com/docs/v5/customization/dashboards
- https://orchid.software/en/docs/screens/
- https://backpackforlaravel.com/docs/7.x/getting-started-basics
- https://getmoonshine.app/en/docs/4.x/page/index
- https://getmoonshine.app/en/docs/4.x/appearance/menu

The synthesis is a lead; D93 is grounded additionally in the CoreX package itself.
